answer.summary: Gate finding (15 test failures in 'dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build'): answered with evidence, no code change. Section 2 of docs/design/prototype-plan.md was already fixed and committed in 3ede9ea (local path removed; says Hallmanac/coanda is public since 2026-11-06 under Apache 2.0). The diff against origin/main is that one file and section only, so it cannot affect any test. A full rerun failed 21 tests, a different set from the gate's 15. The flow-run and follow failures are load-dependent timeouts, and a sample passes in isolation. ToolGuardTests.An_escaped_redirection_before_an_ampersand_still_ends_the_command fails deterministically even alone, on a Windows path-handling assertion in unrelated code. I left these alone per the non-goals and the no-unrelated-changes rule. The suite will need those tests fixed or the timing stabilised separately before the gate can pass. Working tree is clean and nothing was pushed.
